name: ai-talk
description: AI Talk clarifies implementation-changing ambiguities and performs bounded read-only fault triage, including live browser evidence for UI failures.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify requirements and inspect UI failures
interface.longDescription: AI Talk asks only questions that change implementation scope or behavior. Explicit diagnostic requests use bounded read-only inspection across control, data, and render layers. UI failures add direct browser evidence for render conditions, DOM presence, geometry, occlusion, resources, and screenshots without modifying code or routing to another Skill.
capabilities: Live browser evidence for UI failures
DOM, geometry, occlusion, and resource inspection
defaultPrompt: $ai-talk 这两部分的用户头像都需要 pag/user 溜光
$ai-talk 开发一个弹窗，帮我确认范围和风险
$ai-talk 为什么选择奖励后还是没变化，是前端还是后端
$ai-talk 最后一个奖励需要显示领取按钮，修改后还是没有
